description: List the comments and reactions on one published post, per channel, read from each platform. Each channel's entry has its postPlatformId and each comment its id, which reply_to_comment and moderate_comment take, plus commentActions listing the actions that channel supports. Some platforms have no comment access (TikTok, Pinterest, Google Business, Telegram, Snapchat) and say so in a notice. Use this when the user asks who commented on one of their published posts, or needs a comment's id to reply to or moderate it.
name: list_post_comments
title: List post comments
